description: Do the REAL model work with NO fakes: download the real Laya web-agent model, load it on-device through @receptron/laya, run real inference, and capture real per-step latency and autonomy numbers with the LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated tests and benchmark. docs/PLAN.md's spike VERIFIED that abedinia/laya-web-agent (ModernBERT-shaped) exports to ONNX and loads via Laya.load({ modelDir }) after a tokenizer special-token rename (<bos>/<eos>/<mask>/<pad> -> [CLS]/[SEP]/[MASK]/[PAD], same IDs), and that the reference convaiinnovations/laya checkpoint loads directly. Network is OPEN_INTERNET and Python 3.12 is available via `uv`. Produce a working local ONNX bundle directory, point LAYA_MODEL_DIR at it, and run the gated real-weights tests plus `LAYA_MODEL_DIR=<dir> pnpm run bench` to get REAL numbers (real inference output + latency, real % fully autonomous, and the independent final-page verification still holding - a DONE decision is NOT proof of success). If abedinia/laya-web-agent underperforms the reference on the measured benchmark, evaluate the reference convaiinnovations/laya (or another @receptron/laya-compatible ONNX-modelDir option) and pick the best on the evidence, justified with numbers. Then clear all temporary files created during download/export (scratch dirs, the Python venv, downloaded weights) - the repo .gitignore already excludes *.onnx / *.onnx.data / model/ / .venv/ / .cache/, so NEVER commit weights; verify `git status` is clean of large/temp artifacts afterward. Add a documented, reproducible prepare script or documented steps (not committed weights) so anyone can reproduce the bundle.
steps: Create a scratch working directory OUTSIDE the tracked source (e.g. /tmp/laya-model-work or a gitignored path) for all downloads and the Python venv, so cleanup is trivial and nothing large ever lands in a tracked path.
Set up Python 3.12 via `uv` in the scratch dir with torch, transformers, onnx, onnxscript, onnxruntime, safetensors, huggingface_hub (mirror the versions docs/PLAN.md recorded for the spike).

Attempt path A (reference, simplest): download convaiinnovations/laya and load it directly via a tiny Node script that calls Laya.load({ modelDir }) (or via createEngine({ modelDir })). If it loads and runs a narrow choice question, capture the real distribution + input_tokens + latency.

Attempt path B (web-agent, the product model): snapshot_download('abedinia/laya-web-agent'), run @receptron/laya's export/export_onnx.py against it (pulling rl_common.py/rl_agent_api.py/email_utils.py from convaiinnovations/laya as the spike documented), then RENAME the four tokenizer special tokens in tokenizer/tokenizer.json (<bos>/<eos>/<mask>/<pad> -> [CLS]/[SEP]/[MASK]/[PAD], keeping the SAME token IDs) before loading. Load the produced bundle via Laya.load({ modelDir }) in Node and capture real inference output + latency.

Point LAYA_MODEL_DIR at the produced bundle directory and run `LAYA_MODEL_DIR=<dir> pnpm test` so the gated real-weights blocks (test/autopilot.test.ts describe.skipIf at line 338, test/benchmark/report.test.ts it.skipIf at line 43) actually execute against the real model. Capture the real outcome (done/max_steps/blocked), and confirm the independent final-page verification result is reported honestly.
Run `LAYA_MODEL_DIR=<dir> pnpm run bench` to get the real-engine coverage table and per-step latency on the offline fixtures. Record the numbers.

Measure the north-star metrics with the real model on the broadened benchmark (built in FEAT-004 if run after; otherwise on the current fixtures): per-step latency and % fully autonomous (from FEAT-002's autonomy summary), so 'faster and autonomous while reliable' is backed by real before/after numbers. Do NOT regress the independent verification.

If abedinia/laya-web-agent underperforms convaiinnovations/laya (or another compatible model) on the measured evidence, run the alternative through the same gated tests + bench, compare the numbers head-to-head, and pick the best; record which model won and why (with the measured figures).

If the real model genuinely underperforms the deterministic rule layer on structured tasks, document that honestly (the rules do most of the structured work; the model helps on ambiguous steps) rather than inflating a number.

Update docs/PLAN.md's VERIFIED/INFERRED/GUESSED ledger with EXACTLY what was run this session: which model loaded, the real latency/autonomy numbers, and the reproduce steps. Add a documented prepare procedure (a script under a scripts/ dir OR clear steps in docs) that recreates the bundle from scratch. Do NOT commit any weights.

Clear temporary files: remove the scratch working dir, the Python venv, and any downloaded/exported weights. Run `git status --porcelain --ignored` and confirm no *.onnx / *.onnx.data / model/ / .venv / large scratch artifacts are tracked or staged. The working tree must be clean of temp artifacts (only intended source/doc/test changes remain).
Run `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run build`, and `pnpm test` (offline, WITHOUT LAYA_MODEL_DIR) to confirm the offline suite is still green with the stub and no weights.
acceptance_criteria: A real Laya ONNX bundle was downloaded/exported and loaded via @receptron/laya's Laya.load({ modelDir }) in Node, with real inference output captured (not a fake/stub).
`LAYA_MODEL_DIR=<dir> pnpm test` runs the gated real-weights tests against the real model and they pass (the real-weights autopilot test accepts done/max_steps/blocked outcomes).
`LAYA_MODEL_DIR=<dir> pnpm run bench` produced a real-engine coverage table and per-step latency numbers, which are recorded in the findings and docs/PLAN.md.
Real per-step latency and % fully autonomous numbers were captured; if a model choice was made between web-agent and reference, it is justified with the measured figures.
No weights, venv, or scratch artifacts are committed or staged; `git status --porcelain --ignored` shows the tree clean of large/temp files after cleanup.
docs/PLAN.md ledger updated with what was actually run, and a reproducible prepare procedure is documented.
The offline suite (`pnpm test` without LAYA_MODEL_DIR) remains fully green with the stub and no weights.
